The new prompt-object version was 2x faster on eval 1 (64s vs 130s) but similar speed on evals 2 and 3

Key finding: the prompt-object version trades procedure compliance for speed and token efficiency, but loses reliability on specific mandated behaviors (critical-patterns check)
